data.text: Anders' agent is building apps/speech/voice_station.py, a standalone loop on the physical board. btn_kitchen press → laptop mic → ElevenLabs STT → answer on the board's tft (office_say) and spoken on the board speaker (macOS say Nora TTS → 16 kHz PCM chunks via speaker_play_pcm; verified to play in real time). Air questions are answered from live co2_co2/aht20 readings; other requests go to the API. Noah (final-interface-feedback): reuse this for board voice output instead of building a second one. It holds the board's serial port while running, so the bridge can't run at the same time.
